resources.title: Investor memo cover, type only
resources.purpose: Open an investor deck with the company name, one plain sentence on what it does, and the round, amount and date, without a logo or illustration.
resources.notes:
Purpose: Open an investor deck with who the company is, what it does in one plain sentence, and what it is asking for.
Modify: Edit `deck`: company name (it is set as type, not drawn), the one-sentence description, round, amount, date and contact. Keep the sentence to three lines at this width and the name short enough to stay left of column 7 (about eight letters at 208 px).
Invariant: The name is the first read, the sentence the second, the round and date the third. No illustration, no tagline, no logo mark; the amount matches the ask page.
Static: Already static.
deriveSteps: Edit `deck`: company name, the one-sentence description, round, amount, date and contact.
Keep the sentence to three lines in the right-hand column and the name to about eight letters at 208 px.
Check that the amount matches the ask page.

resources.title: Problem measured per customer, with one worked example
resources.purpose: Prove the customer problem is real and common by showing it measured for every audited customer, with the median and one concrete case.
resources.notes:
Purpose: Size the customer problem with evidence the investor can check, and make it concrete with one real kitchen.
Modify: Replace `kitchens` with your own audit (one value per customer or interviewee) and `example` with one of them; the headline fraction, median line, callout and description recompute.
Invariant: Bars start at zero and are sorted; the median is computed, not typed; exactly one bar is highlighted and it is the one the callout describes; the source line says how the data was collected.
Static: Already static.
deriveSteps: Replace `kitchens` with one measured value per customer or interviewee.
Choose one of them as `example` and fill in the concrete facts: size, spend, what was lost.
Keep the headline fraction computed from the median; change the noun if your unit is not money.
Rewrite the source line with how and when the data was collected.

resources.title: Bottom-up market sizing as a calculation table
resources.purpose: Size the market bottom-up so investors can redo the arithmetic: who is counted, how many, at what price, with TAM, SAM and SOM on one linear scale.
resources.notes:
Purpose: Size the market bottom-up so an investor can redo the arithmetic: who is counted, how many, at what price.
Modify: Edit `price` and the three `tiers` (kitchen counts and the one-clause definition of who is counted); SOM is a share of SAM by a stated year. Values, bars and the headline recompute.
Invariant: Value = locations × price for every row; bars share one linear scale starting at zero (the SOM bar is meant to look small); SOM is labelled as a plan, not a forecast; the price matches the unit-economics page.
Static: Already static.
deriveSteps: Set `price` to your annual price per unit (location, seat, household).
Count units for TAM and SAM and write the one-clause filter that defines each.
Set SOM as a share of SAM by a named year; values, bars and the headline recompute.
Name the sources of your counts in the source line.

resources.title: Unit economics: one customer's P&L and payback curve
resources.purpose: Show how one customer makes money and in which month its contribution repays what it cost to acquire.
resources.notes:
Purpose: Show how one customer makes money and how long it takes to repay what it cost to win.
Modify: Edit `unit` (price, cost lines, CAC, churn, onboarding ramp). The P&L column, the curve, the payback marker, the 24-month multiple and the headline recompute. Use the churn you report on the traction page.
Invariant: The curve is cumulative and churn-adjusted; the CAC line and the curve share one axis that starts at zero; the payback month is computed, not typed; the P&L lines add up.
Static: Already static.
tags: ユニットエコノミクス
deriveSteps: Edit `unit`: price, cost-to-serve lines, CAC, monthly churn and the onboarding ramp.
Use the churn reported on the traction page so the two pages agree.
Check that the P&L lines add up and that the payback month in the headline matches the marker.

resources.title: ARR by month with two supporting metrics
resources.purpose: Prove momentum with one honest monthly revenue series and two numbers that show the product works and customers stay.
resources.notes:
Purpose: Prove momentum with one honest monthly series and two numbers that say the product works and customers stay.
Modify: Replace `months` (live customers at month end; ARR = live × price), `cancelled` and the before/after audit values. Every label, the headline and both metrics recompute.
Invariant: Bars start at zero with no axis break; only the latest month is in the accent; ARR uses the same price as the market and unit-economics pages; churn is cancellations over billed customer-months.
Static: Already static.
deriveSteps: Replace `months` with customers live at each month end; ARR = live customers × price.
Set `cancelled` and the before/after outcome values for your first cohort.
Rewrite the two rail sentences around your own outcome and retention measures.

resources.title: The ask: raise, use of funds, milestones and founders
resources.purpose: Close the pitch with how much is being raised, where it goes, what it buys by when, and who will do it.
resources.notes:
Purpose: Close the pitch with the amount, where it goes, what it buys and who will do it.
Modify: Edit `ask` (raise, runway, fund shares, CAC, price, today’s numbers) and `founders` (one credential each, the one that matters for this company). Dollar amounts, the kitchen target and target ARR recompute; the module throws if the shares do not sum to 100%.
Invariant: One proportional bar for use of funds, labelled in place; new kitchens = sales budget ÷ CAC (churn not netted, as the source line says); target ARR = target kitchens × the same price as the other pages; the accent marks the money that buys the milestone.
Static: Already static.
deriveSteps: Edit `ask`: raise, runway, fund shares (they must sum to 100%), CAC, price and today's numbers.
Mark the fund line that buys the main milestone (`buysKitchens`) and rename the unit for your business.
Replace `founders` with one relevant credential per person.
Check that target ARR uses the same price as the market and traction pages.

resources.title: Quarterly business review cover, type only
resources.purpose: Identifies the document (company, period, meeting, author) on a sober title page, leaving the verdict to the next page instead of a summary dashboard.
resources.notes:
Purpose: 会議の名前・対象期間・日付・作成者だけを静かに示し、資料の素性を一目で分かるようにする。
Modify: doc の会社名・年度・四半期・会議日・作成部署を書き換える。対象期間（4月始まりの年度）と曜日は自動計算。3月決算以外の会社は firstMonth の式を自社の期首月に合わせる。
Invariant: 文字だけで構成する（ロゴ・図・数値サマリーを置かない）。結論は2ページ目以降で述べる。社外秘などの取扱区分は実際の規程に合わせる。
Static: Already static.
deriveSteps: Set doc.company, fiscalYear and quarter; the period (April-start fiscal year) and the meeting weekday are computed.
Change the meeting name and date, the authoring department and the classification line (社外秘).
Keep the cover to type: no logo, chart or KPI strip — the conclusion belongs on page 2.
For a fiscal year that does not start in April, change the firstMonth formula.

resources.title: Key metrics against plan and last year in one table
resources.purpose: Shows which headline metrics met plan and which one missed, in a single ruled table read top to bottom rather than a grid of KPI cards.
resources.notes:
Purpose: 主要指標の実績を計画・前年同期と並べ、どれが計画に届かなかったかを1つの表で示す。カードを並べず、上から順に読める表にする。
Modify: kpis に指標を足し引きする（6〜8行まで）。各行は8四半期の実績（今期が最後）、今期計画、kind（金額＝増減率％、比率＝差pt）、better（低いほど良い指標は down）を持つ。計画比・前年同期比・未達の判定・見出し・推移線は自動。quarters と source、running も更新する。
Invariant: 赤は未達の行の計画比だけに使い、必ず「未達」と書く。▲や▼は使わない（日本の帳票では▲はマイナスを表す）。前年同期比は4四半期前との比較。推移線は形を見るためのもので、縦軸は行ごとに異なると注記する。
Static: Already static.
deriveSteps: Replace kpis: 8 quarters of actuals (this quarter last), this quarter's plan, kind ('amount' → growth %, 'rate' → difference pt) and better ('up' or 'down').
Plan and year-on-year ratios, the 未達 flag, the trend lines and the headline recompute; update quarters, source and page.
Keep red for the missed row only, always with the word 未達; never use ▲/▼.
Stay at 6–8 rows; move further metrics to an appendix table.

resources.title: Operating profit bridge from plan to actual
resources.purpose: Explains why operating profit beat plan driver by driver and tests the quality of the beat by isolating the one driver that flattered it.
resources.notes:
Purpose: 営業利益が計画に対してなぜ上振れたかを要因別に分解し、上振れの「質」を問う。数字の大きさではなく、どの要因が効いたかを見せる。
Modify: plan・actual・drivers（計画との差、符号付き、百万円）を書き換える。合計が合わなければエラーになる。focus を付けた要因が紺で強調され、右欄の「その要因を除いた計画差」と見出しが自動で再計算される。hiring と右欄の説明文は自社の事情に合わせる。
Invariant: 計画（枠線）＋要因＝実績（塗り）。棒はゼロから立ち上げる。強調する要因は1つだけ。増減の向きは色ではなく位置と符号で示す。
Static: Already static.
deriveSteps: Enter plan, actual and the signed drivers in 百万円; the module throws if plan + drivers ≠ actual.
Mark the one driver the page is about with focus: it turns navy and the rail computes the variance without it.
Rewrite the rail sentences (hiring, the largest overrun note) with your own causes.
Use '\n' in a driver label to set its line break under the bar.

resources.title: Sales funnel: the step where conversion fell
resources.purpose: Locates the single funnel step whose conversion dropped against last quarter and sizes what that drop cost in new ARR.
resources.notes:
Purpose: リードから受注までの各段階を前期と比べ、どの段階で取りこぼしたかを1か所に絞って示す。右欄で「その段階が前期並みならどうだったか」を金額にする。
Modify: stages（段階名・転換率の呼び名・今期と前期の件数）と newArr（今期実績と計画、2ページと同じ値）を書き換える。最も悪化した段階、その強調、右欄の受注件数と新規ARRの試算、見出しの数値は自動。cause と右欄の要因の文は実際の調査結果に合わせる。
Invariant: 棒の長さは件数に比例し、全段階で同じ目盛り（受注の棒が短いのは実際に少ないから）。強調は1段階だけ。試算は「その段階だけ前期の転換率、他は今期の転換率、平均受注額は今期」という前提を右欄に書く。
Static: Already static.
deriveSteps: Replace stages with this and last quarter's counts and the name of each conversion rate.
Set newArr (actual and plan, same as the KPI page); the worst step, the extra deals and the counterfactual ARR recompute.
Rewrite the cause sentence in the rail from your own diagnosis (staffing, lead quality, response time).
Keep one shared bar scale and highlight only one step.

resources.title: Customer retention by contract cohort
resources.purpose: Compares retention of cohorts before and after an onboarding change at the same age, so the effect is not confused with customer tenure.
resources.notes:
Purpose: 契約時期ごとの継続率を経過期間で揃えて並べ、施策の前と後のコホートを同じ経過期間で比べる。
Modify: cohorts（契約時期と、経過1四半期目からの継続率）を実データに置き換える。changeFrom は施策後の最初のコホート、compareAt は比べる経過四半期。色の段階、比較列の枠、平均、見出しの差は自動。コホートは8つ程度まで（それ以上は半期単位にまとめる）。
Invariant: 色は1色相の明度だけで、数値も全セルに書く（16px以上）。比較は同じ経過期間どうしで行い、まだ到達していないコホートは平均に含めない。
Static: Already static.
deriveSteps: Replace cohorts with your retention rows (contract quarter, then quarters since contract); keep about 8 cohorts.
Set changeFrom, changeMonth and compareAt; the separator, the framed comparison column, the averages and the headline follow.
Adjust steps (start value and width) so the seven colour steps cover your range.
State the basis of retention (logo or revenue) in the source line.

resources.title: Next-quarter priorities with owner, KPI and date
resources.purpose: Turns the review's findings into three ranked priorities that each carry one owner, one KPI target and one date.
resources.notes:
Purpose: 本資料の分析から導いた次四半期の重点施策を、責任者・KPI・期限つきで合意する。会議の最後に「誰が・何を・いつまでに」を確定させるページ。
Modify: priorities を3件（多くても4件）に絞って書き換える。各施策に根拠のページ、KPI（現状→目標）、責任者1名、期限1つを置く。KPIの現状値は funnel・onboarding・cloud の今期の値から計算される。quarter、note、running も更新する。
Invariant: 上から重要な順に並べる（1が最優先）。施策は動詞で終わる具体的な行動にする。責任者は部署名ではなく個人名と役職。期限は日付で書く。
Static: Already static.
deriveSteps: Write three priorities as concrete actions, most important first, each citing the page it comes from.
Give each one KPI (now → target), one named owner with title, and one date; current values compute from the funnel, onboarding and cloud figures.
Update quarter, note and running title for your period.
Make the headline name the first priority and its target.

resources.title: Strategy proposal cover (Japanese consulting deck)
resources.purpose: States who the proposal is for, what it proposes, by when and who presents it, before any argument begins.
resources.notes:
Purpose: 誰に、何の提案を、いつ・どの場で出すのかを一目で伝える。結論は次のページから。
Modify: deck の提出先・題名・到達目標（年度と利益率）・日付・会社名・担当者・機密区分を差し替える。題名は2行以内に収める。
Invariant: 表紙に図や飾りを置かない。到達目標の数字は推奨案のページ（2029年度 6.0%）と一致させる。
Static: 静的ページ。
deriveSteps: Replace client, title, kind, meeting, date, firm, team and classification in the deck object.
Set deck.target to the goal the recommendation page proves (year and operating margin).
Keep the title to two lines at 68 px; shorten the wording rather than shrinking the type.
Change the accent only through --st-accent (and the --ss-* tokens) in pack.css.

resources.title: Issue tree with quantified hypotheses
resources.purpose: Breaks one target into testable questions, each with a numeric hypothesis and effect, so the meeting sees where the required improvement can come from.
resources.notes:
Purpose: 「6%に届くか」という大きな問いを、検証できる問いと数値の仮説に分け、どこに改善余地が集まっているかを示す。 Modify: plan（売上・利益・前提）と tree（論点・問い・仮説・効果）を差し替える。合計、必要額、棒の長さ、接続線は自動で計算される。focus: true の論点が強調色になる。見出しの改行は
で文や句の切れ目に入れる。 Invariant: 線は分解を表し、順序ではない。各問いは「はい／いいえ」で答えられる形にし、仮説には必ず数値を入れる。効果の単位と年度は全ページでそろえる（2029年度・億円）。 Static: 静的ページ。
deriveSteps: Enter baseline profit, sales, target margin and market effects in plan; the required improvement is computed.
Write the root and branch labels as explicit line arrays, and each leaf as a yes/no question plus a hypothesis containing a number.
Give every leaf its effect v (億円); bars, branch totals and the headline share update from the data.
Mark the branch the headline is about with focus: true so its bars and total take the accent.

resources.title: Priority matrix: effect versus ease, labelled scatter
resources.purpose: Ranks candidate initiatives by effect and ease against stated thresholds and sums each zone, so the meeting can agree what to start first and what to drop.
resources.notes:
Purpose: 論点ツリーで洗い出した打ち手を「効果」と「実行の容易さ」で並べ、どれから着手し、どれを見送るかを決める。 Modify: levers の効果（億円）・容易さ（1〜5）・ラベルの側 side を差し替える。境界 cut を変えると色分け、網掛け、右の表の合計が追従する。ラベルが境界線や図の端にかかる場合は自動で反対側に置かれる。見出しの改行は
で文や句の切れ目に入れる。 Invariant: 打ち手の番号と効果は論点ツリーと同じ値にする。境界は明記した数値で引き、目分量で決めない。容易さの採点方法を注記する。 Static: 静的ページ。
deriveSteps: Copy lever numbers and effects from the issue tree; score ease 1–5 and state the scoring method in the footnote.
Set cut (ease and effect thresholds); point colours, the tinted zone and the rail sums follow.
Pick a label side per point; a label that would cross a threshold or the frame flips automatically — check the render.
Keep required equal to the issue tree so the headline share stays true.

resources.title: Options comparison table with Harvey balls
resources.purpose: Compares three ways to reach the target on the same criteria — numbers where they exist, scored judgments with reasons where they do not — without hiding the recommended option's weak points.
resources.notes:
Purpose: 実現手段の3案を同じ評価軸で並べ、推奨案がどこで優れ、どこで劣るかを隠さずに見せる。 Modify: effect（打ち手別の効果）、options（含む打ち手・投資・回収の計算方法）、judged（4段階の評価と根拠）を差し替える。営業利益・利益率・回収年数は自動で計算される。rec: true の列が網掛けになる。見出しの改行は
で文や句の切れ目に入れる。 Invariant: 評価軸はすべて「●ほど良い」の向きにそろえる。数値で言えるものは数値で書き、評価記号には必ず短い根拠を添える。推奨案の弱点も残す。 Static: 静的ページ。
deriveSteps: Enter the lever effects and, per option, its levers, investment and the effects that repay it; profit, margin and payback are computed.
Phrase every judged criterion so that a full ball means better, score 0–4 and add a one-line reason.
Set rec: true on the recommended option to tint its column; keep its low scores visible.
Keep descriptions and reasons to one line so the table ends above the footnote.

resources.title: Recommendation with an operating-profit bridge
resources.purpose: Commits to one option and shows how operating profit builds from this year's actual to the target year, separating the plan's levers from market effects.
resources.notes:
Purpose: 推奨案を1つに絞って言い切り、営業利益が2025年度の実績から2029年度の計画までどう積み上がるかを示す。 Modify: option（推奨案）、sales（売上高）、steps（増減要因と金額、kind、2行の項目名）、conditions（実現の条件と期限）を差し替える。最後の合計は図のエンジン（waterfallChart）が積み上げ、利益率と見出しの数値も自動で計算される。kind: plan の項目が強調色になる。見出しの改行は
で文や句の切れ目に入れる。 Invariant: 合計＝前の合計＋増減の和（入力で上書きしない）。外部要因（売上の伸び・コスト上昇）は灰色、打ち手は強調色に分け、マイナスの要因も必ず載せる。条件の日付はロードマップと一致させる。 Static: 静的ページ。
deriveSteps: Enter steps: the actual total, market effects (kind: 'market'), lever groups (kind: 'plan') and a final total without a value — it is summed, never typed.
Enter sales for both years so the margins under the two totals are computed.
List the dated conditions that the roadmap page schedules.
Keep investment and linked effects equal to the options page so the payback matches.

resources.title: Roadmap: phases, milestones and year-end KPIs on one time axis
resources.purpose: Shows when each initiative runs, which dated milestones the plan depends on and what the KPIs should read at each year-end, all on one shared time axis.
resources.notes:
Purpose: 推奨案をいつ・どの順で実行し、各年度末にどの指標がどこまで動くかを1枚で約束する。 Modify: axis（期間）、phases（段階）、work（打ち手ごとの期間と節目、月番号は2026年4月＝0）、kpis（年度末の値）を差し替える。営業利益率は営業利益と売上高から計算される。見出しの改行は
で文や句の切れ目に入れる。 Invariant: 打ち手の番号は論点ツリーと同じにする。節目の日付は推奨案ページの「実現の条件」と一致させ、2029年度末の値は推奨案の数値（利益率6.0%）と一致させる。 Static: 静的ページ。
deriveSteps: Set axis (months counted from the first fiscal April) and the phases.
Enter each lever's bar and milestone in months; calendar labels such as 2028年3月 are generated from the month index.
Enter year-end KPI values; the operating margin is computed from profit and sales.
Check that milestone dates match the recommendation page and the final-year margin matches its bridge.

resources.title: Research talk cover: title, authors with affiliations, venue and date
resources.purpose: Tells the room what the talk is about, who presents it and where it belongs, on one type-led page that also shows the study's own specimen.
resources.notes:
Purpose: 発表の題目と、誰が・どこで・いつ話すのかを一目で伝える表紙。タイトルだけで研究の対象と条件（ラベル50枚・ひび割れ検出）がわかるようにする。
Modify: talk の title（2行に分けた配列）・subtitle・authors・affiliations・venue・date・session を書き換える。発表者に presenter:true を付けると名前の前に○が付く。曜日は date から自動で求める。
Invariant: タイトルは2行以内で、句の途中で改行しない。著者の上付き数字と所属の番号を一致させる。会議名・日付・セッションは表紙にだけ置き、各ページには繰り返さない。
Static: 静的ページ。
deriveSteps: Replace talk.title (two lines, broken between phrases), subtitle, venue, date and session; the weekday is computed from the date.
List authors with 1-based affiliation numbers and set presenter:true on the speaker (the ○ mark is added).
Replace the crack geometry with your own specimen, or swap the SVG for a real image and keep the caption honest about what it is.
Keep the title to two lines at 80 px; shorten the wording rather than shrinking the type.

resources.title: Background: why pixel-level labels are scarce, with the task drawn pixel for pixel
resources.purpose: Shows the task and its cost — an image patch and its mask rasterised from one geometry, and the hours needed to label everything — so the research question follows from the evidence.
resources.notes:
Purpose: なぜラベルが足りないのかを、作業の単位（1画素）と作業時間の掛け算で示し、研究の問いを置く。
Modify: cost の枚数・橋の数・1枚あたりの時間・正解を付けた枚数を実際の値にする（右の計算と時間は自動で再計算）。crack の座標と幅を変えると (a)(b) とその説明文の画素数・割合が再計算される。実画像を使う場合は (a) を画像に替え、(b) は実際の正解マスクにする。
Invariant: (a) と (b) は同じ範囲・同じ縮尺。模式図であることを図の下に書く。右の計算は 枚数 × 時間 = 合計 の順で、単位を省かない。
Static: 静的ページ。
deriveSteps: Set cost (image count, minutes per mask, labelled count); the calculation rail and the question recompute.
Edit crack (centreline points with widths), or replace panel (a) with a real crop and (b) with its real mask at the same scale.
Keep the note that the figure is a schematic, or replace it with the image's source and acquisition details.
Rewrite the question so it names the labelled count, the unlabelled pool and what is measured.

resources.title: Method: training pipeline plus a computed zoom on the one new idea
resources.purpose: Explains the whole training loop at a glance and proves the contribution on a worked example: the same probability map thresholded once versus twice.
resources.notes:
Purpose: 手法の全体（教師が擬似ラベルを作り、生徒が学ぶ）と、新しい一点（2段のしきい値）を1枚で示す。上段は流れ、下段は同じ確率マップでの比較。
Modify: setup の枚数としきい値を書き換える。下段の確率マップは crack から合成した模式図で、途切れの数と残る画素の割合は自動で数える。実データの例に替える場合は prob を実際の確率マップに置き換える。

resources.notes:
Purpose: Give the reader a pause and the essay’s argument in one sentence, at a size that cannot be skimmed.
Modify: Replace `quote.text` with a sentence from your own text (about 15–25 words, so it sets in three or four lines). Quote a person only with their real, sourced words and name them.
Invariant: One sentence; the opening quotation mark hangs outside the text edge; the rust quotation marks are the only colour; this is the only dark page in the pack.
Static: Already static.
deriveSteps: Replace `quote.text` with one sentence from your own text, 15–25 words.
Quote a person only with their real, sourced words, and name them.
Use this dark page once per deck.

resources.title: Proportional timeline with a magnified last minute
resources.purpose: Make a contrast of scale felt, months against seconds, with two linear timelines where the second magnifies the end of the first.
resources.notes:
Purpose: Make a contrast of scale felt: 7 months of waiting against a 28-second pour, without a log scale that hides it.
Modify: Edit `journey` (days per stage, in order) and `lastMinute` (seconds, one item marked pour). Stage widths, inside/outside labels, the magnification factor, the headline ratio and the closing note recompute.
Invariant: Both rows are linear and the same width; row 2 is exactly the last minute of row 1; only the pour is rust; durations are labelled on the marks; the source says the values are typical, not measured.
Static: Already static.
deriveSteps: List the `journey` stages in order with their duration in days.
List the `lastMinute` steps in seconds and mark the one the page is about.
Keep both rows linear and the same width; the magnification, headline ratio and note recompute.
Say in the source line where the durations come from.

resources.title: Recipe as five numbers, set as a typographic table
resources.purpose: Set the handful of numbers that define something at display size, each with its unit, a name and one sentence on what it controls.
resources.notes:
Purpose: Show that the 28 seconds are one setting among five, and give each number a sentence that says what it controls.
Modify: Edit `recipe` (dose, yield, time, temperature); the ratio and the flow rate in the time row recompute. Keep each sentence to one line (about 45 characters) so the five rows fit the page. Rewrite the headline in the way a practitioner says the recipe aloud, and update `words` if the numbers change.
Invariant: Every numeral carries its unit; derived numbers are computed, not typed; the numerals share one size and line up on their right edge; no colour on this page.
Static: Already static.
deriveSteps: Edit `recipe`; the ratio and the flow rate recompute.
Rewrite each row's sentence as one line that says what the number controls.
Rewrite the headline the way a practitioner says the numbers aloud, and update `words`.

resources.title: Closing page: last paragraph, end mark and credits
resources.purpose: End the essay on its own last paragraph, then credit the author and every picture and number used in the piece.
resources.notes:
Purpose: End the essay on its own last paragraph, then tell the reader who wrote it and where every picture and number came from.
Modify: Replace `ending` with the real final paragraph (two to four sentences; any durations must agree with the timeline page), `author` with a one-line note, and `credits` with one entry per image, chart or data source in the piece.
Invariant: The end mark closes the text and is the only colour; no summary of takeaways and no slogan; every image used in the piece is credited here with its licence.
Static: Already static.
deriveSteps: Replace `ending` with the real final paragraph; keep any durations in agreement with the timeline page.
Write a one-line author note.
Add one credit per image, chart or data source used in the piece.

resources.title: Annual report opener: the year in one sentence and four figures
resources.purpose: Opens an annual report with one plain sentence about what changed and four defined figures, so readers know the scale and the results before any detail.
resources.notes:
Purpose: 表紙を兼ねて、どの団体の何年度の報告かと、この一年の変化を平易な一文と4つの数字で伝える。 Modify: org、districts（地域別ページと同じ表）、prev（前年度）、sessions、stay、exam を差し替える。文中の増分と4つの数字は計算で出る。見出しの改行は
で文や句の切れ目に入れる。 Invariant: 数字は4つまで。どの数字にも「何を数えたか」を添える。率は分母を書く。一文は事実を言い、標語にしない。 Static: 静的ページ。
deriveSteps: Enter districts (shared with the regions page), the previous year, sessions, retention and graduation counts; totals and rates are computed.
Rewrite the sentence so it states the year's change in plain words, not a slogan.
Keep four figures; give each a label and a definition, and state the denominator of every rate.

resources.title: Reach by district: bars with their denominators
resources.purpose: Compares how much of the eligible population each district reaches, with the denominators on the page, to justify where the next site should open.
resources.notes:
Purpose: 地区ごとに「支援が必要な子どものうち、どれだけに届いているか」を比べ、次の教室をどこに開くかの根拠を示す。 Modify: districts の教室数・参加者数・対象者数を差し替える。割合、並び順、市全体の値、強調する地区（割合が最も低い地区）は自動で決まる。note には強調した地区の事情を一文で書く。見出しの改行は
で文や句の切れ目に入れる。 Invariant: 割合の分母（対象の子ども）を必ず表に出す。参加者の合計は1ページ目の486人と一致させる。地図は使わない（位置関係を捏造しない）。 Static: 静的ページ。
deriveSteps: Enter each district's sites, participants and eligible children; reach, sort order, the city total and the highlighted district are computed.
Write one plain sentence in note explaining the highlighted district.
State the source and date of the eligible count in the footnote.
Keep the participant total equal to the opener page.

resources.title: Logic model: from resources to measured outcomes
resources.purpose: Explains where the outcome numbers come from by laying out resources, activities, outputs and outcomes as one flow, each outcome with how it was measured.
resources.notes:
Purpose: 1年間の事業を「使った資源→行ったこと→直接の結果→子どもに起きた変化」の順に並べ、成果の数字がどこから来たか、どう測ったかを1枚で示す。 Modify: K（各ページと共通の数値）と stages の項目・測り方を差し替える。各段階は3項目まで。見出しの改行は
で文や句の切れ目に入れる。 Invariant: 事業費は予算ページ、参加者数は1・2ページと同じ値にする。アウトカムには必ず測り方（調査名・時期・人数）を添える。線は想定する流れであり、変化がすべて事業の効果だとは言わない。 Static: 静的ページ。
deriveSteps: Update K with the figures shared with the other pages (spending, participants, sessions, survey results).
Keep three items per stage, each with a number, a one-line label and a one-line note.
Give every outcome its measurement: instrument, timing and number of respondents.
Keep the footnote that the arrows show the assumed flow, not proven causation.

resources.title: Spending as one proportional bar, with cost per child
resources.purpose: Shows where the money went in one proportional bar and turns the total into cost per child and per visit, with the division printed under each figure.
resources.notes:
Purpose: 寄付と委託費がどこに使われたかを1本の帯で示し、子ども一人・1回あたりの費用に言い換えて実感できる大きさにする。
Modify: spend（万円、room: true が教室の運営費）と income、参加者数・延べ参加数を差し替える。帯の幅、割合、ラベルの段、一人あたりの費用、見出しの「約◯万円」は自動で計算される。
Invariant: 帯の合計＝支出合計。一人あたり＝支出合計÷実人数、1回あたり＝支出合計÷延べ参加。割り算の式をページに残す。事務局の費用も隠さない。
Static: 静的ページ。
deriveSteps: Enter spend items in 万円 and mark classroom costs with room: true; segment widths, shares, label rows and the bracket are computed.
Enter participants and total visits; cost per child, cost per visit and the rounded headline amount are computed.
Enter income lines; the footnote shows the income total and the balance carried forward.
Keep the administration item visible in the bar.

resources.title: Voices: three short quotes set as typography
resources.purpose: Adds what numbers cannot show — a child's, a parent's and a teacher's own words — attributed by role and place, without portraits or icons.
resources.notes:
Purpose: 数字では伝わらない変化を、本人・家庭・学校という3つの立場の言葉で確かめる。
Modify: voices を、本人の了解を得た実際の声に差し替える（最初の声が大きく入る）。立場と所属は、個人が特定されない粒度にとどめる。source に集め方を書く。
Invariant: 声は短く、言い換えずに載せる（要約した場合は注記する）。架空の声を実在の声として見せない。顔写真やイラストを添えない。
Static: 静的ページ。
deriveSteps: Replace voices with consented quotes; the first one is set large.
Attribute by role and site only, at a level that does not identify the person.
Describe how the quotes were collected in source; keep the fictional-example note until real quotes are used.
Keep the large quote under about 70 characters so it stays within five lines.

resources.title: Next year: targets with baselines and measurement
resources.purpose: Commits to next year's targets beside this year's results and states how and when each one will be measured.
resources.notes:
Purpose: この一年の結果から来年度の目標を数値で約束し、それぞれをどう測るかまで示す。 Modify: now（今年度の実績）、focus（教室を開く地区）、targets（目標・測り方）を差し替える。地区の割合は参加者数と対象者数から計算される。見出しの改行は
で文や句の切れ目に入れる。 Invariant: 目標は必ず今年度の実績と並べ、測り方と時期を書く。実績は前のページと同じ値にする。計画は予定として書き、決まっていないことは断定しない。 Static: 静的ページ。
deriveSteps: Enter this year's results in now (the same values as earlier pages) and the district to expand in focus.
Write each target with its baseline, goal and a method with timing; mark the key row with key: true.
Use words such as 全員 where a number is not the point; they are set as words, not as figures.
Say in the footnote who decided the targets and when.

resources.title: Launch hero with one product fragment
resources.purpose: Open a launch with the product's name, what changed in one sentence, when customers get it, and one honest piece of the product.
resources.notes:
Purpose: Open a launch with the product's name, what changed in one sentence, when customers get it, and one real piece of the product so the claim is concrete.
Modify: Edit launch.name, launch.changed (one sentence, a mechanism, not a slogan), launch.availability (dates and plans) and the rule fragment (one object from your product, worded as the UI shows it).
Invariant: The name appears once in the deck, here, in green. The fragment is flat, legible (18 px) and labelled as sample data; no device frame. Dates must match the close.
Static: No builds.
deriveSteps: Set the product name and version as the display line, in the brand colour, once in the deck.
Write what changed as one sentence that names the mechanism, not a slogan.
Give availability as dated lines per plan or region, matching the close.
Replace the rule with one real object from your product at 18 px, labelled as sample data.

resources.title: What's new as a list with one measured proof each
resources.purpose: Say what a release does as jobs, each backed by one number from real use, so buyers can map the features to their own work.
resources.notes:
Purpose: Say what is new as jobs the product now does, each backed by one number from real use, so the audience can map features to their own work.
Modify: Edit features (3–4 items): plans (must match 04-pricing), name (fits one line at 26 px in columns 1–3), does (one sentence, two lines at most), proof (one measured number) and what (what it measures, ≤ 36 characters). Edit beta for the evidence base.
Invariant: One number per capability, each with its unit and what it measures; the evidence base is stated in the source line. Plans agree with the pricing page.
Static: No builds.
deriveSteps: Pick three or four capabilities and name each as a job that fits one line at 26 px.
Write one sentence of at most two lines per capability saying what it does.
Give one measured number per capability and what it measures in at most 36 characters.
State the evidence base in the source line and keep plan availability identical to the pricing page.

resources.title: Before and after on one time axis
resources.purpose: Prove a release's main claim with one concrete case: where the time went before and what is left of it now, on one shared axis.
resources.notes:
Purpose: Prove the launch's main claim with one concrete case: where a return's time went before, and what is left of it now.
Modify: Edit the two phase lists (minutes from the request; kind team/customer/carrier/auto; after:true for steps that no longer hold up the refund) and the lane names. Bars, durations, both refund ticks, the headline and the description recompute. Raise DAYS if the slower lane is longer than five days.
Invariant: Both lanes share one axis that starts at the request. Unchanged time (the carrier) stays visible in both lanes so the gain is not overstated. Green is 2.0 only; dark grey is time spent waiting on your team.
Static: No builds.
deriveSteps: Time one real case end to end in both versions, as phases in minutes from the request.
Tag each phase team, customer, carrier or auto, and mark steps that no longer hold up the outcome as after.
Raise DAYS until the slower lane fits; bars, refund ticks, labels and the headline recompute.
Keep unchanged time visible in both lanes so the gain is not overstated.

resources.title: Pricing table with one recommended plan
resources.purpose: Let each buyer find their plan by monthly volume, see what an upgrade adds, and see which plan is recommended and why.
resources.notes:
Purpose: Let each buyer find their plan by monthly volume, see what the upgrade adds, and know which plan we recommend and why.
Modify: Edit plans (price, included returns, overage, features, limits, support) and the rows list; mark one plan with pick:true. The headline, the green rule and the title follow the data. Keep feature names identical to 02-features.
Invariant: One row per attribute, identical across plans, so absence shows as a dash. Exactly one recommended plan, marked only by its middle position and the rule over its column. Currency, tax and billing terms in the note.
Static: No builds.
deriveSteps: Enter each plan's price, included volume, overage, features and limits in plans.
Keep one row per attribute so absence shows as a dash.
Mark exactly one plan with pick:true and keep it in the middle; the green rule and the headline follow.
State currency, tax and what every plan includes in the note line.

resources.title: Step-by-system integration matrix
resources.purpose: Show which existing system connects at which step of the workflow, and what this release adds.
resources.notes:
Purpose: Show where the product sits among systems the customer already runs — which system connects at which step — and what this release adds.
Modify: Edit steps (in order), systems (rows) and links (system, step, what passes in ≤ 15 characters, isNew for this release). Positions, drops, colours, the key and the description follow the data.
Invariant: One row per system, one column per step, in the order a return happens. Green only for what is new in this release, and the key on the bottom line names it; everything else is grey.
Static: No builds.
deriveSteps: List the workflow's steps in order and the systems your customers already run.
Add one link per connection with what passes in at most 15 characters; set isNew for this release.
Name the steps that call no outside system in inside.
Rewrite the headline to name the new connection that matters most.

resources.title: Launch close: dates, first steps, migration
resources.purpose: End a launch with the dates that matter, the first three things a customer does, and what happens to what they use now.
resources.notes:
Purpose: End a launch with the dates that matter, the first three things a customer does, and what happens to what they have now.
Modify: Edit dates (mark the launch day today:true; must match the hero), start (three imperative steps, in order), migration (what moves by itself, what the customer must do, by when) and contact.
Invariant: Dates in order on one rule; only today's dot is green. Steps are numbered because they are a sequence. Future items are stated as dates, not promises.
Static: No builds.
deriveSteps: Enter the dates in order and mark the launch day today:true, matching the hero.
Write three imperative steps in the order a customer takes them.
Say what moves by itself, what the customer must change, and by when.
Put the guide link and the help contact on the bottom line.

resources.title: Project status summary with decisions needed today
resources.purpose: Tells a steering committee on one page the overall status, the three reasons behind it and the decisions it must take today.
resources.notes:
Purpose: 会議の冒頭1枚で、全体の状況・その理由・今日決めてほしいことを伝える。細部は2ページ以降に任せる。
Modify: overall と areas の状況（ok／warn／late）、dev・bufferWeeks・uat の数値、asks（判断事項と期限）を書き換える。完了見込み日・遅れの週数・予備期間の残りは自動計算。project の会議名と日付、asOf（基準日）は全ページで同じ値にする。
Invariant: 状況は色の点と言葉（順調／注意／遅延）を必ず併記する。全体の判定は最も悪い領域を無視しない。要点は3つまで、1行目が結論、2行目が根拠。判断事項には期限を付け、詳細ページを示す。
Static: Already static.
tags: ステアリングコミッティ
deriveSteps: Set overall and area statuses (ok / warn / late); colour always appears with the word 順調／注意／遅延.
Update dev, bufferWeeks, uat and goLive; the forecast date, slip and remaining buffer in the messages recompute.
List at most two asks with deadlines and keep project, asOf and the meeting date identical on all six pages.
Keep the status criteria in the note line in sync with how your PMO rates status.

resources.title: Milestones: baseline against forecast with the status date
resources.purpose: Shows on one date axis which phases slipped against the approved baseline, by how much, and whether the remaining buffer still protects go-live.
resources.notes:
Purpose: 基準計画に対してどの工程がどれだけずれ、予備期間と本番稼働日にどう響くかを1本の日付軸で示す。
Modify: phases の plan（基準計画）と fc（実績・見込み）、state、進行中の工程の status、buffer、cutover、asOf を書き換える（YYYY-MM-DD）。ずれの週数、予備期間の残り、見出しは自動。期間が変わったら span も直す。
Invariant: 基準計画の線は消さずに残す。見込みは基準日時点の実績から計算した日付にする（3ページのバーンダウンと同じ日付）。状況の色は言葉と一緒にだけ使う。本番稼働日を最後の行で必ず示す。
Static: Already static.
deriveSteps: Enter each phase's baseline (plan) and actual/forecast (fc) dates, its state, and a status only for active phases.
Set buffer, cutover and asOf; slips (+n週), the remaining buffer and the headline recompute.
Take the development forecast from the burn-down page so both pages show the same date.
Change span if the project runs outside April 2026 – May 2027.

resources.title: Development burn-down with a velocity-based finish date
resources.purpose: Replaces a gut-feel delay estimate with a finish date computed from recent velocity, set against the original plan line.
resources.notes:
Purpose: 開発の残作業を計画線と比べ、今のペースだといつ終わるかを日付で示す。遅れを「感覚」ではなく速度から説明する。
Modify: sprint（初日・日数・計画スプリント数）、scope、done（各スプリントの完了ポイント）、added（変更要求で増えたポイント）、change の注記を書き換える。残り・平均速度・完了見込み日・必要なペース・見出しは自動。見込みに使うスプリント数は lookback で変える。
Invariant: 縦軸は0から。計画線は当初計画のまま残し、スコープの追加は注記で示す。見込みの計算方法（直近3スプリントの平均）を注記に書く。完了見込み日は2ページの工程表と一致させる。
Static: Already static.
deriveSteps: Set sprint (first day, length, planned count) and scope, then enter completed and added points per sprint.
Choose lookback; remaining points, velocity, forecast date, required pace and the headline recompute.
Annotate scope changes with change.sprint and change.label.
Copy the forecast date to the milestones and decisions pages if you edit them separately.

resources.title: RACI matrix for the next project phase
resources.purpose: Agrees who does and who decides each upcoming task, checks one accountable role per row and points at the staffing gap that needs a decision.
resources.notes:
Purpose: 次の工程の主な作業について、誰が実行し誰が最終責任を持つかを合意し、今日決めるべき体制の穴を示す。
Modify: roles（列）と tasks（行と各役割の R／A／C／I）を書き換える。各行の A がちょうど1つでないと読み込み時にエラーになる。focus を付けたセルが強調され、見出しの役割名に使われる。ask の人数・期限・内訳を実際の依頼に合わせる。
Invariant: 文字だけで表す（色付きの札にしない）。A は各行1名、A と R の兼務は A/R と書く。役割は個人名でなく役割名で書く。強調するのは今日の判断に関わるセルだけ。
Static: Already static.
deriveSteps: Replace roles (columns, '\n' for header breaks) and tasks with R / A / C / I per role; a row without exactly one A throws.
Mark the cells the page is about with focus (role id); they take the accent and name the role in the headline.
Update ask (headcount, deadline, sources, period) for the note line.
Use role names, not people, in the matrix.

resources.title: Risk matrix with top risks, owners and actions
resources.purpose: Ranks risks on one likelihood × impact scale and gives owners, actions and dates for the top three, marking the ones today's decisions address.
resources.notes:
Purpose: リスクを同じ物差しで並べ、上位のリスクに誰がいつまでに何をするかを確認する。今日の判断で手当てできるものを区別する。
Modify: risks の各行に、発生可能性 l と影響度 i（1〜3）、上位に入るものには内容・対応策・責任者・期限、判断事項で手当てするものには decision（6ページの番号）を書く。並び順・表に載る上位3件・図の位置・見出しの件数は自動。
Invariant: 優先度はグレーの濃さで示す（状況の色は使わない）。表のリスクには必ず責任者と日付の期限を付ける。今日の判断に関わるリスクだけをアクセント色にする。評価日と評価者を注記に書く。
Static: Already static.
deriveSteps: Rate each risk 1–3 for likelihood (l) and impact (i); give the top ones text, action, owner and due date, the rest a short name.
Add decision (the page-6 number) to risks a decision addresses; they turn teal in the grid and table.
The ranking, the top-three table, the grid positions and the headline counts recompute.
Record who rated the risks and when in the note line.

resources.title: Decision requests: options, recommendation and deadline
resources.purpose: Lets the committee decide on the spot by laying out each decision's options with their consequences, one recommendation and a deadline.
resources.notes:
Purpose: ステアリングコミッティに判断してほしいことを、選択肢・推奨案・期限つきで示し、その場で決められるようにする。
Modify: decisions を書き換える（2件まで。3件以上は2ページに分ける）。各判断に title・due（期限）・比べる列（columns）・options・reason を置く。開発スコープの案は cut（削るポイント）と extraVelocity（増える速度）から完了日を計算するので、dev は3ページと同じ値にする。
Invariant: 各判断に推奨案は1つ。推奨の行は太字と「推奨」の文字で示し、色だけに頼らない。期限は日付で書く。選択肢には「何もしない」案も含め、その結果を書く。
Static: Already static.
deriveSteps: Write at most two decisions, each with title, due date, the columns to compare and two or three options including 'do nothing'.
For schedule options give cut points and extra velocity; completion dates compute from dev (same numbers as the burn-down).
Mark exactly one option recommended and state the reason in one sentence.
Move a third decision to its own page rather than shrinking the type.

resources.title: Stage keynote opener, type only
resources.purpose: Open a talk on a large dark screen with its subject, a two-sentence premise and who is speaking where, with nothing competing for attention.
resources.notes:
Purpose: Open a talk with its subject in the room's largest type, the premise in one plain sentence, and who is speaking where — nothing else competes.
Modify: Edit talk.title (two lines at 88 px; about 16 characters per line), talk.premise (two short sentences, one per line: a fact and the size of the answer, not a slogan), talk.speaker and talk.event.
Invariant: Flat paper, ink only — the yellow is reserved for solar data later in the deck. Title hangs from the 64 px top line with the premise under it at y 286 (the upper part of the screen stays visible over the audience's heads); speaker and event share one baseline at 656, the event starting at the centre line (module 12).
Static: No builds; the page reads at once.
deriveSteps: Write the talk's subject as a two-line title at 88 px (about 16 characters per line).
Write the premise as two short sentences, one per line: the fact that frames the talk and the size of the answer.
Put speaker, role and organisation on module 0 and event, city and date on module 12 of the bottom line.
Keep the page ink only; save the accent colour for the first page that shows the data it stands for.

resources.title: Chapter divider with the number set as a word
resources.purpose: Mark a turn in a long talk and say, with the chapter's key number, what the next part will show.
resources.notes:
Purpose: Mark a turn in a long talk and say in one sentence what the next chapter will prove.
Modify: Edit chapters (short claims, not topic labels), set current to this chapter's index, and rewrite sentence with the chapter's key number. Duplicate the file for each chapter and change current only.

State the refuting test in the mechanism panel.
